meta.title: Courses: lessons, quizzes and certificates · Clafina
meta.description: Courses from video, reading and quiz lessons for your staff and customers, a board that shows where people stop, and numbered certificates. The Courses pack for Clafina.

hero.title: Train your people, and see the lesson where they stop.
hero.lede: For businesses training their own staff, selling courses to customers, and schools and training centres. Learners, lessons, quizzes and certificates in the same place as HR and your invoices.

business.name: Kalabari Supply Company
business.about: A distributor with a warehouse, a fleet of vans and two shops. Ibiere, the training manager, trains new staff and sells places on the shop course to the traders who buy from them.

dayTitle: A day with Kalabari Supply Company's training manager

moments.title: A new course is nearly ready
moments.problem: Ibiere wants the warehouse course out this week, but a half-finished course puts people off.
moments.handles: The builder lists the modules and their video, reading, quiz and live lessons, and shows which ones aren't ready. A course can only be published when every lesson is: a video with its file and length, captions when your setting asks for them, a reading with its text, and a quiz with enough questions.

moments.title: The course is published
moments.problem: Now the new warehouse staff need to be on it.
moments.handles: Staff invited while the course was a draft are enrolled the moment it is published, and find it under My learning. Staff come from HR with the sign-in they already have, and are never invoiced.

moments.title: A video skipped to the end
moments.problem: Abiye drags the till video to the end. It shouldn't count as watched.
moments.handles: The player reports what was watched, but Clafina only accepts as much as the time allows and cuts back the rest. A video is done at the share of its real length that you set. Ibiere can see it on her phone.

moments.title: Quiz time
moments.problem: Last time, the answers went round the staff chat.
moments.handles: Each attempt draws its questions from a bank, and the answers are never sent to the learner's browser. Retakes are limited and spaced apart, and a pass is final.

moments.title: A customer wants a paid place
moments.problem: Owanate Traders wants its shop assistant on the shop course, and Kalabari Supply wants to be paid first.
moments.handles: A priced place is invoiced on the normal customer invoice. A setting can hold the learner until the payment is confirmed, and another can ask for approval before anyone starts.

moments.title: Where do people give up?
moments.problem: Plenty of people start the shop course, but not enough finish it.
moments.handles: The learners board shows each person's state for today: finished, not started, on track, stuck or retake. It points to the lesson with the biggest drop, with a hint drawn from that lesson itself. Here it is a short reading with no picture.

moments.title: A cashier finishes
moments.problem: HR needs proof she was trained, and it should be easy to check later.
moments.handles: Finishing gives a numbered certificate with an expiry date and a code to check it by. A staff member's certificate goes onto their HR record as a training record. Staff with the certificates permission can check a code, and a certificate can be withdrawn with a reason and issued again.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina a training team uses
faqTitle: Questions training teams and schools ask

faq.q: Can I train staff and sell the same course to customers?
faq.a: Yes. A course can be open to staff, customers or both. Staff are never invoiced, and customers are invoiced for a priced place.

faq.q: How do I know a video was really watched?
faq.a: Clafina only counts as much of a video as the time allows, so skipping to the end doesn't count. You set the share of the real length that marks it done.
It is much harder. Each attempt draws questions from a bank, the answers never reach the browser, and retakes are limited and spaced apart.

faq.q: Are the certificates recognised outside my business?
faq.a: A certificate here is your business's own. It is numbered, runs out when you set, and can be checked by its code.

faq.q: Can a customer buy a course on my online shop?
faq.a: Yes. Courses can be sold on your online shop, and a place bought there joins the learner to the course.

faq.q: Can a school keep fees by term and parents' details?
faq.a: Yes. The Courses pack keeps fees by term, sends fee statements and holds a parent or guardian record for each learner.
